description_en: Clears device configurations of an edge instance in batches
description_zh: 批量清空边缘实例设备配置
kebab_example: aliyun iot batch-clear-edge-instance-device-config --instance-id F3APY0tPLhmgGtx00000 --iot-ids example-string --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchClearEdgeInstanceDeviceConfig

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for the public instance. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the edge instance. On the Edge Instances page of the IoT Platform console (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), hover over the name of the target edge instance to obtain instance ID.

You can also call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html operation to obtain instance ID
parameters.help_zh:
边缘实例ID。在边缘计算控制台 (https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的边缘实例页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标边缘实例名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135214.html接口获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of device IDs to query. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135261.html operation to query device IDs in the instance.

You can specify up to 20 device IDs in a single call
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备ID列表。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135261.html查询实例中的设备ID。

单次调用最多可填写20个设备ID
parameters.name: iot_ids

Code.description_en: The response code. Success indicates that the call was successful. Other values indicate error codes. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）
Code.description_zh: 接口返回码。Success表示成功，其它表示错误码。详情请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/135200.html）

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call failed
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful. A value of true indicates that the call was successful. A value of false indicates that the call failed
Success.description_zh: 表示是否调用成功。true表示调用成功，false表示调用失败
